item.title: Combiner 0.14.0
item.description:
• ▶ on a synth patch plays it: the patch opens in its own synth on your Mac (Serum 2, Current and any Audio Unit synth; Surge XT too) and plays the track's MIDI, or a short phrase when there's none. A track with no wet render plays its patch the same way.
  • MIDI previews start at the first note, not at the start of the project (a part at bar 31 used to open with a minute of silence).
  • A SORT menu beside TRACKS | LATEST: DAW order, newest, oldest, A–Z, length, or by type (MIDI, patches, samples, recordings, renders, then instrument and audio tracks). Each view keeps its own.
  • The hover card shows after a second, and names where things come from: Project, DAW, From computer.
  • Under the hood: each Combiner now proves who it is to the others in a room, for saved people and invites coming next. Everyone in a room needs 0.14.0.
